CEO Mark Jeftovic disclosed the breach on the company blog on 27 November at 20:56 UTC. A day earlier, easyDNS had told customers who keep their own AWS keys in its control panel to rotate them immediately . easyDNS is a Canadian registrar and DNS host, founded in 1998. items.summary: This essay originally appeared in The Guardian . It’s an expanded version of the one I posted as “ We Get the Infrastructure We Pay For .” It’s been a bad week for our computerized infrastructure. We’ve seen outages at Microsoft , the FAA , a handful of banks , United Airlines , an unnamed classified NSA network , and Apple . People should be forgiven for suspecting a coordinated cyberattack, a common cause, or at least a conspiracy. But there is none. The incidents are unrelated.
